title: QueryRequest
description: Request body for executing a SQL SELECT statement and returning a result set.

sql.description: The SQL SELECT statement to execute. Any valid SingleStore SQL SELECT syntax is supported.

database.description: Name of the database to query. If not provided, the default database for the authenticated user is used.

args.description: Positional arguments for parameterized SQL queries. Use ? placeholders in the sql field and provide values in order here.
